title: Torrent Builder presets.yaml
description: Torrent Builder preset configuration file. Each named preset holds per-tracker settings merged in via --preset <name>. NOTE: the `configFields` definition is intentionally duplicated in batch.json (job-level overrides accept the same fields) so each schema stays self-contained and portable across editors/validators. Keep the two copies in sync.

version.description: Preset file format version. Only 1 is supported.

default.description: Defaults merged under every preset. Lowest precedence in the merge hierarchy: CLI flags > preset values > default section > built-in defaults.

presets.description: Named presets. Keys are arbitrary preset names (passed to --preset). Values use the same fields as `default`. An empty preset (`{}`) is valid.

items.description: Tracker announce URL. Must be http://, https://, or udp://.
Web seed URL. Must be http://, https://, or udp://.

source.description: Source field embedding (e.g. a tracker tag like "PTP").

piece_size.description: Piece size in KB (e.g. 4096 = 4MB). Powers of two only. Mutually exclusive with target_piece_count.

target_piece_count.description: Desired number of pieces; piece size is calculated from content size. Mutually exclusive with piece_size.

creator.description: Created-by field. Overrides the default "Torrent Builder". Set no_creator: true to omit.

creation_date.description: Whether to embed creation date. Set no_date: true to omit.

no_creator.description: Explicitly omit the creator field. Takes precedence over `creator`.

no_date.description: Explicitly omit the creation date. Takes precedence over `creation_date`.

exclude_patterns.description: Glob patterns to exclude. Supports *, **, and ?.

include_patterns.description: Glob whitelist: when non-empty, only files matching a pattern are kept (matching also overrides exclude patterns). Supports *, **, and ?.

builtin_excludes.description: Apply built-in system-file exclusions (.DS_Store, Thumbs.db, etc.).

allOf.description: piece_size and target_piece_count are mutually exclusive.
